# Draft:American Ninja Warrior Obstacles

----
These Are The Obstacles Of American Ninja Warrior From The First Season In 2009 To The Sixteenth Season In 2024 And How To Do Them
Qualifying
American Ninja Warrior Season 1
Quintuple Steps: You Must Run Across Five Steps That Are Angled To A Larger Angled Platform
Seasons:1, 5-7
Rope Swing: You Must Grab A Rope And Swing Over A Gorge Of Water To Another Platform
Seasons:1-2
Barrel Roll/Spinning Log: In Season 1 You Must Run Across A Giant Barrel That Barely Moves, In Season 4 You Must Run Across A Slimmer Log That Spins, And From Season 6 Semifinals Onward You Must Run Across A Thin Log With A Donut In The Middle To Trip You
Seasons: Barrel Roll:1 Spinning Log:4, 6, 13
Spider Wall/Spider Jump: In Season 1 You Must Jump In Between 2 Wood Wall Across A Gorge Of Water, In Season 2 You Do The Same But The Walls Are Glass
Seasons:1-2
Pipe Slider: In Season 1 You Must Grab A Bar A Slide It Across A Track With 3 Drops, In Season 4 You Do The Same Thing But There Is No Drops And The Bar Is Slippery
Seasons:1, 4
Warped Wall: In Season 1 You Run Up A 14 Foot Curved-Bottom Wall, In Season 2 You Do The Same But The Wall Is Now Fully Curved, In Season 10 It’s Still The Same But It’s Now 14.5 Feet
Seasons:1-16
This Is Just A Preview To See If It’s Good Or Not
(Please I Beg Of You It Be Good)
